messages:
maria: uploaded a new draft for trace export options. big UX question: when someone clicks Export, should we default to a single .zip bundle (with attachments + JSON) or give an inline modal letting them pick 'JSON only', 'CSV (flat)', or 'ZIP (all)'. Support wants fast single-click; compliance wants explicit format choice. figma: https://figma.com/s/trace-export-options

*leo:* my vote: default to ZIP but show a tiny chevron on the export action that opens a compact menu for other formats. keeps one-click for power users but surfaces options. also think about the generated filename pattern — should be stable and SR-friendly.

*anu:* agree on zip default. accessibility: the export menu must be keyboard-navigable and announce the selected format. when a format is chosen, we should provide a polite `aria-live` confirmation like 'Export ready: trace-2026-03-23-<id>.zip'. don't read the full correlation id aloud though.

*sam:* UX nuance: CSV flattening loses nested metadata (headers, tags). if we offer CSV, show a short helper line: 'CSV flattens nested fields; use JSON for full fidelity.' maybe a small link to docs. also ensure filenames include timezone to avoid confusion for distributed teams. e.g., `trace_2026-03-23T18-04-05Z_<shortid>.zip`

*maria:* edge cases: attachments can be large. we should surface an estimated size after selection and warn if > 50MB with a confirm step. default ZIP can be streamed; but large export should show a progress toast and SR announce 'Export started' with an option to email when ready.

*leo:* implementation note: make the download control a real button and the chevron a separate focusable popup trigger. avoid combining both in one element to reduce keyboard complexity. tab order: CID -> more -> export button -> chevron.

*anu:* a11y nit: for the export modal/menu, use `role="menu"` and ensure each option has `role="menuitemradio"` with `aria-checked` state so SR users know the selected format. also expose a `Download as...` heading and move focus into the menu when opened; restore focus to the export button on close.

*sam:* copy suggestions for the confirm warning for big exports: 'Export may take several minutes and produce a large file (>50MB). Continue?' buttons: 'Continue' and 'Cancel'. for the email-when-ready option, checkbox text: 'Email me when this export is ready'.

*maria:* decision proposal:
- default action: single-click Download (ZIP, includes attachments + metadata)
- chevron next to button opens accessible format menu: JSON, CSV (flat), ZIP (all)
- filename pattern: `trace_<ISOtimestamp>_<shortid>.<ext>` (ISO timestamp uses hyphens to be filesystem-safe)
- show estimated size; if >50MB show confirm dialog with 'Email me when ready' option
- use `role="menu"` + `menuitemradio` for options; move focus into menu
- `aria-live` polite announcements for 'Export started' and final 'Export ready' (no raw IDs spoken)
- tab order: CID -> more -> export -> chevron

*leo:* acceptance criteria:
- keyboard: chevron opens menu; options reachable/activatable via arrows/enter; focus restored on close
- SR: menu announced with options and selection state; polite announcements on start/ready
- filenames: follow pattern and avoid reading full ids in SR messages
- large export: shows size estimate and confirm dialog with email opt-in

*design-bot:* accessibility checklist: menu roles present, `aria-checked` states, focus trapping during modal, `aria-live` for status updates, contrast for size warning, reduced-motion respected for progress animation. Missing: tests for filename spoken by SR if user chooses 'announce filename' preference.

*maria:* i'll update figma with the chevron+menu pattern and add the size warning modal. @anu can you draft the exact ARIA attributes? @sam can you write the small helper copy for CSV/JSON differences? i'll prototype and push keyboard interactions.

*anu:* will draft ARIA attrs: `button` for export, `aria-haspopup="menu"` on chevron, menu with `role="menu"`, items as `role="menuitemradio"` and `aria-checked` toggles, `aria-live="polite"` region id `export-status` for updates. will avoid including raw IDs in SR text.

*sam:* will write helper copy and the large-export copy. quick draft for helper: 'CSV flattens nested fields; use JSON to retain full metadata. Attachments included only in ZIP.'

*maria:* thanks. leaving this open until prototype pushed. please react if you're good with the plan. :thumbsup:
